findings.title: P2: Reject retained temporary files before allowing another publication
findings.body: If writing or syncing the temporary file fails before os.link(), the temporary file remains but the destination name does not exist. A subsequent call checks only the destination and chooses a new UUID, so it can publish successfully despite the unfinished prior attempt. For stage bundle publication, another invocation using a different local output path can therefore proceed past a failed control attempt. This contradicts the documented terminal failure rule that unfinished temporaries poison later use. Add a durable reservation associated with the destination, or detect its retained temporary state before permitting another publication, while preserving failure evidence.

overall_explanation: The metadata capacity and remaining-deadline corrections are present, but retained temporary publication failures do not enforce the promised terminal once-only control behavior. Review was limited to read-only source inspection; tests were not run.
